Island guide

Choose a map pin to play. Each first visit adds a stamp to your island passport. Switch between Grown-up and Little Me on your player card. Each keeps her own look.

Dress-Up Studio: outfits, shoes and jewelry, each with color swatches. Beauty Salon: hairstyles, hair color, makeup, nails and hair accessories. Tap Surprise me! for a random look from your wardrobe, and Save look to keep up to six favorites per character.

Earn stars by matching cards, delivering bouquets, rehearsing on the runway, helping islanders and photographing style challenges. Spend them on anything with a lock: tap it to try it on, then choose Buy to keep it. Try-ons go back to the shop when you leave the room. Golden hour, the gold postcard frame, unlocks once you have earned 10 stars in all.

Use a mouse, touch, or Tab and Enter. Arrow keys move between room tabs. Your looks, stars, wardrobe and scrapbook save in this browser.
